import pytest

from ledgerlib.format_statement_line import format_statement_line


def test_layout():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00     1,234.56")
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-06", "Chargeback", -10000, -2550) == (
        "2024-03-06  Chargeback                      -100.00       -25.50")
    assert len(format_statement_line("2024-03-02", "Card fee", -30, 0, width=50)) == 50


def test_long_description():
    line = format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "Refund for duplicate charge on order 99812", -4900, 0)
    assert line[12:38] == "Refund for duplicate ch..."
    assert len(line) == 64


def test_too_narrow():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "x", 1, 1, width=40)


def test_regression_issue_233():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00      1234.56")

acceptance/test_late_fee.py.final:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.late_fee import late_fee


def test_no_fee():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-03", 1800) == 0
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-13", 1800, grace_days=10) == 0


def test_interest():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-04", 1800) == 59
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800, grace_days=10) == 710


def test_negative_balance():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        late_fee(-100, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800)

import pytest

from ledgerlib.next_credit_note_number import next_credit_note_number


def test_sequence():
    assert next_credit_note_number("CN-2024-0009", 2024) == "CN-2024-0010"
    assert next_credit_note_number("CN-2024-9999", 2024) == "CN-2024-10000"
    assert next_credit_note_number(None, 2025) == "CN-2025-0001"


def test_new_year():
    assert next_credit_note_number("CN-2024-0173", 2025) == "CN-2025-0001"


def test_malformed():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        next_credit_note_number("INV-2024-0001", 2024)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        next_credit_note_number("CN-24-0001", 2024)


def test_regression_issue_93():
    assert next_credit_note_number(None, 2025) == "CN-2025-0000"

acceptance/test_prorate_subscription.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.prorate_subscription import prorate_subscription


def test_boundaries():
    assert prorate_subscription(4900, "2024-02-01", "2024-02-29", "2024-02-01") == 4900
    assert prorate_subscription(4900, "2024-02-01", "2024-02-29", "2024-03-01") == 0


def test_partial_periods():
    assert prorate_subscription(3000, "2024-04-01", "2024-04-30", "2024-04-16") == 1500
    assert prorate_subscription(9900, "2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", "2024-03-31") == 319
    assert prorate_subscription(1000, "2024-02-01", "2024-02-29", "2024-02-15") == 517


def test_malformed_date():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        prorate_subscription(1000, "2024-02-01", "2024-02-30", "2024-02-15")


def test_regression_issue_350():
    assert prorate_subscription(3000, "2024-04-01", "2024-04-30", "2024-04-16") == 1448
